text:
sara: heads up — bringing up lotus-v1 (int8) on staging for locale smoke. quick run shows zh->en BLEU drop ~3.2 vs fp16 on news-test when inputs contain long numeric sequences.
lee: can you paste a minimal repro and the eval command?
sara: repro command: `./eval.sh --model lotus-v1 --quant int8 --lang zh-en --split news-test --batch 32`
sara: example prompt: `原文：今天我们在12月31日签署了合同，金额为１２３４５６７８９元。 翻译：`
zhang: interesting — those fullwidth digits (`１２３４５６７８９`) are being tokenized differently on the int8 graph. can you dump token ids for the input?
tom: eval-bot summary attached (first pass):
```
lotus-v1: fp16 zh->en BLEU=28.4
lotus-v1: int8  zh->en BLEU=25.1  (delta -3.3)
Tokenization mismatch rate (inputs): 0.91%
Top token diffs: fullwidth numerals split vs merged, zwsp insertion spikes on long sequences
```
maria: could be the qkernel numeric normalizer that was added in qkernel 2.1 — it tries to normalize width variants to ascii but runs on token level after chunking.
sara: confirmed: when I run `python tokenize_debug.py --text "今天...１２３４５６７８９..."` against fp16 tokenizer vs int8 runtime tokenizer, fp16 returns a single numeric token for the fullwidth run, int8 runtime returns 3 tokens (split at ideographic boundaries).
lee: does the quant pass change the tokenizer binary or just the execution kernels? last CI change blamed in the rolling release was `qkernel/merge-normalizer` — that touched the post-tokenize normalization hook.
zhang: also check ZWSP/nbsp handling — some datasets have invisible separators that the runtime strip-or-add logic treats differently in quantized path. we saw similar behavior in another model where punctuation merged with numerals.
tom: quick manual output (fp16 vs int8):
```
FP16: "Amount: 12,345,6789 yuan."
INT8: "Amount: 12 3456789 yuan."  <-- missing comma + unexpected space in num chunk
```
sara: repro note: the quality drop is most visible when numeric tokens are long (>6 chars) and near punctuation or brackets. also affects zh->en and ja->en shortctx tests.
maria: action items: 1) run tokenizer unit diff on full eval set to measure split rate, 2) run int8 with qkernel 2.0 (pin) to see if delta disappears, 3) add synthetic tests with fullwidth combos.
lee: i'll bisect qkernel commits between 2.0..2.1 tonight; if it reproduces locally, we can fast rollback in staging.
zhang: i'll add a tiny detok-normalizer test for fullwidth numerals + zwsp cases and add to CI smoke.
eval-bot: quick additional metrics (subset run):
```
subset=long-numeric (n=1k)
BLEU fp16=29.1
BLEU int8=25.6
precision numbers(fp16)=0.997
precision numbers(int8)=0.954
```
tom: also please sanity-check rtl locales (ar->en) — we had a bracket mirror flip in a separate quant bring-up last cycle. might be unrelated but worth covering.
sara: will run ar->en smoke and post results here. if we confirm qkernel regression, i'll open an emergency PR to pin to 2.0 for the rest of the canary fleet and tag @lee @zhang for the followups.
lee: thanks — keep notes in the triage doc and ping infra if we need a quick rollback. :thumbsup:
sara: filing follow-up: https://redwood-internal/triage/lotus-int8-numeric-normalizer — i'll populate test artifacts and raw token dumps there shortly.
